summary: Each authored slide uses one initial provider call and at most one explicit recovery, with internal multimodal fallback disabled in deck authoring.
invariants: Author deck calls are bounded to initial ordinal 1 and recovery ordinal 2.
Receipts classify the second call as recovery and deck authoring disables inner text-only provider fallback.
Provider-specific reasoning maps logical minimal to the lowest supported effort without another provider call.
forbidden: Do not restore per-error retry budgets, backoff retries, or hidden multimodal provider fallback in author deck.
